source_read: https://www.amigosburgersandshakes.com/ (pages-sitemap.xml, robots.txt and all 41 item pages the script reads, downloaded fresh 2026-10-08 evening; robots.txt allows everything except '*?lightbox='; the site answered 429 Too Many Requests to the first fast attempts, so the final download was one request every 6 seconds, which it accepted)
not_verifiable: allergens: none published for this chain (the item pages and the allergen PDF disagree on 8 of 39 dishes, so the script publishes the guide link only), so there was nothing to compare
notes: Fresh pages re-run through the script reproduce data/source exactly (items.csv, holdback.csv, chain.csv, allergen_guide.csv). Independent read: each page rendered in headless Chromium with JavaScript off and its visible 'kJ | kcal' line parsed with a different regex: all 37 items.csv rows (33 published + 4 held back) match the printed kcal and kJ (kJ blank where the page prints none, e.g. The Boss, Chick N' Rice, Chicken Popcorn); the 4 existing hold-backs (Breakfast Wrap 1899.5 kJ vs 178 kcal, two Veggie Wrap pages, Halloumi Wrap 0 kcal page) are still exactly what the pages print. Only kcal and kJ exist on the site (no protein, carbs or fat). Noted for the founder, left as printed (the script's item notes already say so): several pages carry the same figures as a different dish and look cloned in Wix: Supah Loaded Fries = Buttermilk Burger (463 kcal), Chick'n Pitta = Chick Burger (454), Maple Syrup = Strawberry Pancakes (477), Amigos Wrap = Crispy Korean (278), Breakie = The Boss (1305 kcal for one patty vs two).
